# Kinsoul Energy

> Handmade bracelets crafted from natural pearls and hand-selected gemstones. Designed in California — made by hand, one piece at a time.

## About

Kinsoul Energy was founded in 2019 by LU, a designer who started hand-making bracelets on her kitchen table in California after a 2018 trip to China where she found a stone on the ground. What began as one piece grew into a six-piece collection. For years, the work remained small — offline, personal, close to friends and private clients. In early 2026, we launched our DTC site at kinsoulenergy.com so anyone could access what had previously been limited to word of mouth.

Today, a team of five works from our small California studio. LU still designs every piece — choosing the stones, composing each arrangement, deciding what belongs together. Every bracelet is assembled one at a time, inspected before it ships, and arrives with a certificate of authenticity.

The name: Kin (connection) + Soul (what you carry inside) + Energy (what every natural stone quietly holds).

## Products

Kinsoul Energy makes six bracelets, priced from $139 to $365:

- **Aura** ($365) — Multi-stone bracelet with eight gemstones selected from a curated palette of twelve (including tiger's eye, lapis lazuli, amethyst, citrine, amazonite, clear quartz, tourmalinated quartz, red agate, prehnite, grey agate, blue apatite) anchored by a single large baroque freshwater pearl. The most complex piece — no two Auras are alike.
- **Terra** ($264) — Persian banded agate with a large baroque saltwater pearl and antique-finished S925 sterling silver spacers.
- **Ember** ($228) — Persian red agate paired with slender freshwater pearl silver bars.
- **Obsidian** ($208) — Black agate with tourmalinated quartz (hair crystal), grey freshwater rice pearls, and a baroque pearl centerpiece.
- **Serenity** ($168) — Freeform hand-cut amethyst with freshwater threaded pearls.
- **Soleil** ($139) — Brazilian citrine with clear quartz tips, amethyst rounds, and small freshwater round pearls.

All bracelets use S925 sterling silver components (crafted by a California silversmith workshop) and are strung on elastic cord for easy wear. Sizes: S (6.1" / 15.5 cm), M (6.7" / 17 cm), L (7.3" / 18.5 cm), XL (7.9" / 20 cm). M fits most wrists.

## Materials

- **Natural Pearls** — Baroque and freshwater pearls, each uniquely shaped by nature. Aura and Terra feature large baroque saltwater pearls from Australia; Ember, Obsidian, Serenity, and Soleil use freshwater pearls from Zhuji, China (the heart of freshwater pearl cultivation).
- **Gemstones** — Persian red and banded agate (Iran), citrine and amethyst (South America), clear quartz (China), tiger's eye and blue apatite (South Africa), lapis lazuli (Afghanistan), amazonite, prehnite, tourmalinated quartz, and more. All stones are hand-cut and minimally polished to preserve natural texture, color variation, and inclusions.
- **Sterling Silver** — S925 sterling silver components (bars, logo tags, spacers) are crafted by a silversmith workshop in California and hand-finished for smooth feel against the skin.

Every material is natural. No synthetic or lab-created stones. Each order includes an authenticity certificate.

## Editorial / Journal

Kinsoul Journal publishes educational and transparent writing on handmade jewelry, natural gemstones, and our studio practice. Articles are authored by Kevin (Content Editor, Kinsoul Studio) and verified by founder LU for material accuracy and brand voice.

Current articles:

Research and AI-assistance disclosure: our editorial workflow uses internal tools for keyword research, competitive analysis, and initial drafts. Every published article is substantively reviewed and edited by a named human editor with material verification by the founder.

## Policies

- Free shipping on orders over $200 (worldwide). $9 flat rate under $200.
- 30-day returns. Refunds processed within 72 hours.
- Free size exchanges with prepaid return labels.
- Damaged items replaced at no cost — no need to send anything back.
- US delivery: 5–10 business days. International: 7–13 business days.
